principles: Classify research objects separately from explanatory claims.
Multiple terms may apply; do not force a primary label.
Do not infer causation or appropriation from an observed asymmetry.
Only assign terms supported by the publication or its documented profile.
Add terms through editorial review with a definition and scope.

facets.label: Research objects
facets.description: Phenomena and relations investigated; labels avoid presupposing contested explanations.

terms.label: Value, prices and monetary relations
terms.definition: International and domestic relations of value, prices, wages, currencies, exchange rates and purchasing power.

terms.label: Production, labour and surplus relations
terms.definition: Organisation and distribution of labour, production, surplus, ownership and control.

terms.label: Material and ecological relations
terms.definition: Flows and uses of materials, energy, land, labour embodied in production, and environmental burdens.

terms.label: Fiscal and financial relations
terms.definition: Taxation, debt, credit, fiscal revenues, financial flows and institutions.

terms.label: Development and structural differentiation
terms.definition: Differences and changes in productive structure, development trajectories, technical capacities and provisioning.

terms.label: Political, institutional and territorial relations
terms.definition: State, law, property, coercion, sovereignty and territorial arrangements shaping economic relations.

facets.label: Theoretical frameworks
facets.description: Author-specific interpretations and traditions; classification does not endorse their claims.

terms.label: Ecologically unequal exchange
terms.definition: Theoretical approaches interpreting asymmetric ecological or embodied-resource relations as unequal exchange.

terms.label: Imperialist appropriation
terms.definition: Frameworks interpreting international transfers and economic relations as appropriation structured by imperialism.

terms.label: Needs-based development
terms.definition: Approaches assessing development through basic needs, decent living and provisioning requirements.

terms.label: Delinking and autocentric development
terms.definition: Approaches examining the reorganisation of development priorities away from subordination to world-capitalist accumulation.

terms.label: Law of world value
terms.definition: Frameworks investigating international value relations and their global monetary or developmental expressions.

facets.label: Research orientations
facets.description: The principal intellectual tasks undertaken by a study.

terms.label: Description and measurement
terms.definition: Documents patterns, magnitudes, distributions or indicators.

terms.label: Theoretical or causal explanation
terms.definition: Develops or tests explanations of relationships and processes.

terms.label: Historical reconstruction
terms.definition: Reconstructs development and change in historically specific relations.

terms.label: Evaluation and critique
terms.definition: Assesses methods, theories, policies or normative claims.

terms.label: Transformation and alternatives
terms.definition: Investigates alternative economic arrangements, their requirements or possibilities.

facets.label: Research designs
facets.description: How research questions are translated into investigations.

terms.label: Embodied-flow accounting
terms.definition: Allocates direct and upstream inputs to production, trade or final demand.

terms.label: Comparative monetary analysis
terms.definition: Compares monetary measures across countries, groups or periods.

terms.label: Literature synthesis and scenario comparison
terms.definition: Synthesises published estimates and compares explicit scenarios.

terms.label: Illustrative comparative modelling
terms.definition: Uses stylised models to compare hypothetical or alternative configurations.

terms.label: Historical and structural analysis
terms.definition: Examines the historically constituted relations and conditions of economic outcomes.

terms.label: Environmentally extended MRIO
terms.definition: Multiregional input–output accounting with environmental or physical extensions.

terms.label: Trade in value added
terms.definition: Accounting for value added embodied in production and trade.

terms.label: Piecewise structural equation modelling
terms.definition: Linked regression models for hypothesised statistical relationships.

terms.label: Monetary valuation
terms.definition: Procedures assigning monetary amounts to specified physical or economic quantities.

terms.label: Scenario comparison
terms.definition: Comparison of specified hypothetical or modelled scenarios.

terms.label: Nominal GDP-per-capita ratio
terms.definition: Ratio of nominal GDP per person between specified groups, converted at market exchange rates.

facets.label: Evidence and outputs
facets.description: Types of results or measurements; not necessarily causal conclusions.

terms.label: Embodied physical flows
terms.definition: Estimated embodied material, energy, land or labour quantities.

terms.label: Monetary estimates
terms.definition: Estimated monetary magnitudes or comparisons.

terms.label: Statistical associations
terms.definition: Modelled associations or fit statistics.

terms.label: Needs and resource requirements
terms.definition: Thresholds or scenarios for needs, provisioning, energy and material use.

terms.label: Illustrative development outcomes
terms.definition: Modelled or illustrative differences in growth, prices, distribution or production.

terms.label: Monetary Inequality Index
terms.definition: Ratio of nominal GDP per capita at market exchange rates for two specified groups.
